scope: development repair of the IGCR observation-consumption rule
architecture: unchanged ANS hierarchy and OV-SDF, STGHP, RPN-UQ, IGCR interfaces
single_change_from_v10_1: consume actual mapper.camera_seen cells, but do not blacklist unrealized cells merely because they fell inside an earlier predicted camera footprint
rationale: camera_seen already removes realized observations; predicted-but-occluded cells can remain observable from another pose, so consuming both double-counts an attempt as evidence
main_metric: new unique surface area times final F1@5cm
success_gate: safe S mean exceeds G, N, wrong-semantic X, and no-feedback S; all paired contexts reported
interpretation: development-domain evidence, not held-out generalization or comparison with a separately implemented mainstream system
